description: This file defines the TaskQueue class used for executing tasks in a FIFO order within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It manages task scheduling, optional shutdown behavior, and allows tasks to be added and run asynchronously.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A class implementing a task queue for managing asynchronous tasks in a FIFO manner within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TaskQueue, optionally registering a shutdown function to automatically run remaining tasks unless shutdown is disabled.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task, represented as a callable, to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the queue in order until the queue is empty.

methods.name: disableShutdown
methods.description: Disables the automatic shutdown behavior that runs remaining tasks when the process exits.
